headline: Sets the order of officials who would act as Secretary of the Air Force if the Secretary cannot serve.
what_it_does: This executive order lists which officials would step in to do the job of Secretary of the Air Force if that position is empty or the Secretary is unable to serve. No summary was provided, so the specific officials and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior Department of the Air Force officials
who_it_affects.how: Officials named in the order could be called on to temporarily lead the Department of the Air Force.
